des mtshon nas lho phyogs sogs phyogs gzhan rnams kyi mgon po'i thugs kha nas mgon po'i sprul pa srin po khros pa lta bu re rgyangs te 'phros/ dur khrod so sor byon/ khros pa'i zhabs brdabs/ 'jigs pa'i sgra bsgrags/ dur khrod de dang de'i phyogs skyong gi dmag khros shing 'khrugs pas go gyon mtshon thogs te/ dmag la chas par bsam/ de yang lho phyogs na 'phags skyes po'i dmag las byas gshin rje'i dmag dpon byas pa'i gshin rje'i dmag dang / nub phyogs nas mig mi bzang gis dmag las dang chu lhas dmag dpon byas pa'i chu lha'i dmag dang / byang phyogs nas rnam thos sras kyi dmag las dang / gnod sbyin gyi dmag dpon byas pa'i gnod sbyin gyi dmag dpung / byang shar nas dbang ldan gyi dmag dpon byas pa'i 'byung po'i dmag dpung / shar lho nas me lhas dmag dpon byas pa'i me lha'i dpung / lho nub nas srin po'i dmag dpon byas pa'i bden bral gyi dmag dpung / nub nas rlung lhas dmag dpon byas pa'i rig 'dzin gyi dmag dpung / steng nas tshangs pas dmag dpon byas pa'i lha'i dmag dpung / 'og nas sa'i lha mos dmag dpon byas pa'i sa bdag gi dmag dpung / srin po khros pa lta bu grangs med nyi zer gyi rdul lhags pa bzhin du bun gyis 'phros/ phyogs mtshams steng 'og nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khrig mer gyis khengs shing / de thams cad kyang khro zhing 'khrugs pa/ 'jigs pa'i sgra sgrogs cing rngam pa'i zhabs brdabs pas/ snang srid thams cad yom yom 'gul 'gul byed par bsam/ bdag la gnod par sems pa'i dgra bgegs kyi dmag dpung thams cad sbrang ma'i phung po'am du ba 'khrigs pa bzhin phyogs kun nas nag bun bun slebs byung ba rnams kyis bdag gis sprul pa'i dmag rnams mthong ba tsam gyis stobs nyams/ dpa' zhum go cha dang lag cha'i mdangs nyams te mun 'thom 'thom gnas pa la/

bdag gis sprul pa'i pho nya rnams phar 'phags te/ dgra bgegs stobs nyams pa de rnams bsad/ bcom/ sha zos/ khrag 'thung / rus mur/ go cha dang / lag cha thams cad phrogs te/ bdag nyid kyi go cha dang lag char byas/ phal cher ming med par byas te bcom/ lhag ma cung zad lus pa rnams khro zhing 'khrugs pas gang gis gnod par byed pa de'i steng du phar log ste/ dmag gi sna drangs te song ba'i phyi bzhin du sprul pa'i dmag dpung rnams kyang rngam shing rgyug nas byad ma gang na yod pa'i phyogs su song / mi nor thams cad bcom/ sha zos/ khrag 'thungs/ yul mkhar gnas gzhis thams cad kyang rtsa ba nas bsgyel/ thed ro rnams kyang ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar bas dul gyis bsregs/ thal ba yang mgon po'i rnam 'phrul 'byung ba'i dus kyi 'thor rlung drag pos stong gsum gyi pha mthar yud kyis khyer nas ming tsam yang ma lus par rjes med du song bar bsam zhing shā sa na'i yi dam duṣ+ṭan yan chad spyi ltar la/ byad ma kha kha/ byad ma kha hī kha hī/ byad ma ma ra ma ra/ byad ma gṛh+na gṛh+na/ byad ma bhan+dha bhan+dha/ byad ma ha na ha na/ byad ma da ha da ha/ byad ma pa tsa pa tsa/ byad ma di na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa spel tshig can/ pa tsa yan spyi ltar la byad ma di na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa gsham bu can gang 'os brgya rtsa sogs dang / oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ye/ ya ma rā dza kī li kī la ya bh+yoḥbazlog rbad/ ma ma te kam braṃ pa te bh+yoḥbazlog rbad ces pa'i bzlog pa'i gsham bu can gang 'os brgya rtsa sogs drag tu bzla ba ni/ pho nya spro bsdu zur tsam lags zhes gsungs pa'i don to/ /gnyis pa yang sprul spro ba ni/ rdo rje brag rdzong gi phyogs mtshams steng 'og thams cad dmag gis khengs pa'i bar sngar bzhin/ slar yang rang nyid khros pa'i nyams kyi hūm̐ḥzhes sgra chen po brjod cing zhabs brdabs/ 'jigs pa'i sgra bsgrags/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum phyogs bcur hrig hrig gzigs pas/

phyogs bcu'i mgon po rnams cher khros/ sprul pa'i mgon po rnams kyang cher 'khrugs nas so so'i dur khrod nas bya 'phur ba bzhin du 'ur gyis byon/ so so'i sgar steng du phebs pa dang / khros pa'i zhabs brdabs/ 'jigs pa'i sgra bsgrags pas phyogs skyong gi dmag rnams shin tu khros shing 'khrugs/ dri za'i dmag rnams re re'i ba spu'i bu ga nas dri za'i sprul pa rta pa srin po khros pa lta bu nyi zer gyi rdul lhags pa bzhin du bun gyis 'phros/ gshin rje'i dmag rnams re re'i ba spu'i bu ga nas gshin rje'i sprul pa ma he sngo nag dregs shing khros pa 'phrab mchongs rgyug pa'i rnam pa can du ma dang / chu lha'i dmag rnams re re'i ba spu'i bu ga nas chu lha'i sprul pa dug sprul nag po dug gi kha rlangs sprin ltar stib cing phu 'brug ltar sgrog pa grangs med dang / gnod sbyin re re'i ba spu'i bu ga nas gnod sbyin gyi sprul pa gangs seng rngam pa dpa' zhing gtum pa du ma/ dbang ldan rnams las 'thab glang myos pa stobs ldan/ sna la ral gri btags pa du ma/ me lha rnams las 'phar spyang rngam pa du ma/ srin po rnams las gcan zan dang ru ṭa nag po du ma/ rig 'dzin rnams las rlung lha nag po dus kyi 'thor rlung gtong ba du ma/ steng gi lha rnams las gnam lcags kyi bya khyung nag po sgro gshog mtshon cha me 'bar ba'i rnam pa du ma/ sa bdag re re'i ba spu'i bu ga nas sa bdag gi sprul pa lcags kyi sdig pa nag po g.yag tsam mgo dgu kha dgu mig dgu rwa bco brgyad dang ldan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams 'phros/ phyogs mtshams steng 'og thams cad mer gyis khengs/ de dag gis 'od dang gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum las kyang ches lhag pa/ mthong ba tsam gyis bdag la gnod par sems pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad dpung phyogs kun nas long long 'dus pa kun gyi nus pa thams cad rang nyams rang brlag tu song ste nag thum thum song ba'i khar/

sprul pa yang sprul dang bcas de dag rngam zhing rgyug nas gnod byed thams cad bsad/ bcom/ sha rus don snying thams cad hab thob tu bzhes/ de yang dri za'i sprul pa rta pa rnams kyis dgra bgegs la mtshon cha'i char phab/ ma he rnams kyis rwa kha la blang zhing lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar rdeb pa dang / gnam lcags kyi rmig pa me 'bar bas brdzis shing rdo rje'i lces bldags pas gzhob thul thul bsregs pa dang / dug sbrul mthong ba'i dug can rnams kyis bltas pa tsam gyis dgra bgegs rnams myong shing 'thibs/ kha rlangs kyi dug can rnams kyis kha rlangs phog pa tsam gyis me tog sad kyis khyer ba bzhin du nag rum rum song / rig pa'i dug can rnams kyis dgra bgegs kyi lus la reg pa tsam gyis de dag sbang zan nyi mas brdungs pa bzhin dum bu grangs med par gzhig cing kas te tshar bcad/ de bzhin du seng ge la sogs pas dgra bgegs rnams dum bur gtubs cing sha khrag za ba dang / rlung lha rnams kyis dus kyi 'thor rlung rgyab pas sbrang ma rlung bus khyer ba bzhin gar song cha med par phyogs rnam par klad cing / stong gsum gyi pha mthar yud kyis khyer/ mkha' lding rnams kyi mig dang klad pa rgyu lto rnams phyir byung zhing zos/ sdig pa rnams kyis dgra bgegs rnams rwa bar du btsir te 'jibs pas sha khrag don snying thams cad cig car du zor te lpags pa stong lheb kyi stongs pa sogs 'jigs pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma dang bcas te/ dgra bgegs thams cad ming tsam yang med par btang / stong nyid bde chen gyi ngang du thim song snyam du rig pa brjod med du bzhag cing / shā sa na spel tshig can nam/ gsham bu can gang rigs brgya stong ngam/ drug cu rtsa bzhi sogs bzlas pa'i mthar/ bzlas pa'i gsham bu btags pa nyer gcig sogs drag tu bzlas/ 'jog pa'i tshe/ sngar spros pa'i sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyis dgra bgegs kyi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor sogs rnam pa'i tshul du khyer/

las grub pa'i ngo so dang bcas tshur 'dus/ rang la sib kyis thim pas/ rang nyid brtan zhing nus ldan du gyur par bsam/ lag mthil gnyis su gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan par ral gri zing ba lta bu gcod pa'i rno ngar dang ldan pa'i lag mthil g.yon par dgra bgegs mngon gsum du gnas pa'i steng du g.yas brdabs pas 'khor lo bsnol ba'i bar du dgra bgegs thams cad dmar myog myog dum bu grangs med song bar bsam la/ su gang dag sogs kyi thal mo gnyis mdun du bkan te bzhag lus bcing bar bgyi'o/ /sogs kyi tshe thal mo drag po lan gsum brdabs la/ mthar cung zad mnye ba'i tshul byas 'og tu 'phangs pas sha rus kyi dum bu thams cad 'og gi mgon po'i zhabs 'og tu tshud pa jir gyis mnan pas bskal ba ma stong gi bar du thar ba med par mnan par bsam/ hūm̐ḥzhes brjod pas 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor/ yang hūm̐ḥzhes brjod pas khro bo rnams zhal nang du gzigs par bsam ste/ dmod pa 'dor ba'i dmigs pa 'di dag ni/ bsrung bzlog kun la shes par bya'o/ /de ltar thun mong ma yin pa'i bzlog pa 'di nyid/ gtso bor rbod gtong bzlog gsung mod kyi/ bye brag gi bzlog pa gang la sbyar yang rung zhing 'bad rtsol dang bcas pa nyams su blangs na/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa gang yin yang / nges par bzlog par 'gyur ba ni/ bdag gis yang nas yang du nyams su myong ba yin pas the tshom cung zad kyang yod pa ma yin no/ zhes rje mkhyen brtses gsungs/ /gsum pa bsad pa'i 'khor lo ni/ skyabs 'gro nas 'khor lo jag par bkye ba'i bar sngar bzhin las/ 'og gi sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar chos 'byung mthing nag me 'bar ba'i nang du dgra bgegs gang yin gzugs can gyi rnam pa ji lta ba sdug cing nyams thag pa'i rnam pa can/ zhes brang kheb pa'i snying ga srog gi rten/ khrag mtshal dwangs pa'i mdog lta bu/

mtheb tshag tsam dang bcas pa gsal btab la/ de'i dkyil du rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo hūm̐ḥsngon gcig gsal btab/ 'gugs 'dren yid ches par byas/ rang nyid khros pa'i zhabs brdabs 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ḥsgra drag tu bsgrags pas 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor ba'i mas kyi rtsibs rtses dgra bgegs kyi snying ga nas gzir re drag tu 'khod/ snying rtsa srog rtsa thams cad nyal nyal btub cing bcad sha khrag dmar nyog byung ba rnams sprul pa'i pho nya rnams kyi zos shing tshar bcad par bsam nas/ rnam par shes pa hūm̐ḥyig gi rnam pa de 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyis yar drangs nas/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim pa'am/ spyi rigs bdag mi bskyod pa la thim pa gang rung don la dag pa'i zhing du sangs rgyas pa yin no// sha sa na spel tshig can drag tu bzlas/ mthar dgra bgegs kyi brgyud kyi sdig sgrib bsam ngan thams cad dag nas mi bskyod zhing du sangs rgyas par bsam/ mdor na nag po chen po 'di'i gdul bya'i gtso bor gyur pa ni/ zhi bas 'dul mi nus pa'i ma rung pa dag yin la/ 'dul ba'i thabs kyang / shin tu gdug cing gtum pa la/ /zhi ba nye bar mi sbyar te/ /'di mkhyen rdo rje can gyis ni/ /khro bo de bzhin gshegs kun mdzad/ /ces gsungs pas na bsad pa dang gzir ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas ma rung pa de dag gi las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad bcom nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god nus pa'i phyir/ bsgral bya de dag gi sdig pa sbyong ba'i mchog kyang yin te/ gshin po rjes 'dzin sogs la lho sgo'i cho ga zer ba yang drag po dang mthun pa'i cha nas brtags/ rten bcas rnam shes bkug sdig pa sbyangs nas gnas spor byed pa dang tshul mtshungs par/ dgra bgegs kyi gzugs can bskyed/ rnam shes bkug 'khor lo dang mtshon cha sogs kyis btub pa'i dmigs pa byed pa ni/ de'i las ngan bsog pa'i rten du gyur pa'i rnam smin gyi lus sdig pa dang bcas pa 'joms pa'i thabs yin pas bsgral bya de la'ang phan zhing /

lta bas zin pa'i las sbyor 'di lta bu ni rang gi lam gyi bogs 'don du'ang 'gyur ba yin gsungs/ des na bzlog bsad kyi dmigs pa 'di dag gang nyams su len kyang / bsam pa rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba med par/ sems can thams cad kyi phan bde ni bstan pa rin po che la rag las pa yin la/ de'i phyir rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku la bdo ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde/ sems can yongs la 'tshe ba/ rnal 'byor pa rang gi sa lam bsgrub pa la bar chad byed nges kyi dgra la sogs pa bsgral ba'i zhing bcu la gtogs pa gdug pa can 'di dag gis bstan pa nyams par byed pas/ skye dgu thams cad la dus cig car du gnod pa byas par 'gyur/ de ltar sdig pa'i phung po mi zad pa de'i mthus kho rang yang mnar med pa'i dmyal ba chen por bzod brlag med pa'i sdug bsngal la longs spyod pa shin tu snying rje/ des na las ngan gsog pa'i rten du gyur pa'i lus sems so sor phral te/ rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i zhing du bskyel bar bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pa dang / bye brag tu bdag la gnod pa byed mkhan 'di rnams bdag gi pha ma yin zhing / bdag gi bu byas pa'i 'brel pa can yin pa/ skye shi 'phos pas ngo mi shes par dus kun tu gnod pa 'dis mtshon/ bstan pa dang sems can gzhan la yang gnod pa mang du byas/ rgyu 'bras kyi sdug bsngal tshad med pa la spyod dgos pa snying rje/ des na gnod sbyin gyis smyo ba lta bu la 'dre bsdungs dang me mtshon sogs thabs du ma phan 'dogs pa bzhin du gnod byed 'di rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i slad du drag po'i las 'di lta bu bsgrub snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pas kun nas blangs/ dngos gzhi snying rje khros pa'i zhe sdang bcas pas so so'i dmigs pa gsal zhing brtan par bsgom/ mthar bsgral bya de'i sems dang /

rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug dbyer med du bsres nas bzhag pas don gyi mi bskyod pa'i zhing du sangs rgyas pa ni gnas spar ba'i sbyor ba ste dmigs thun re la sbyor sgrol lhan gcig tu 'byung ba yin pas/ rjes su rang sems brjod bral blo 'das kyi ngang du 'dzin pa ma zhugs par 'jog pa yun gang ring byed pa ni gnad kyi don yin gsungs/ des na rgyun gyi nyams len du mjug tu spyi'i bzlog pa thun re nges par bsgom dgos la/ de'i tshe bstan pa la sdang ba'i mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad 'khor los btub pa'i dmigs pa ma chag par byas nas/ bsnyen bsgrub mthar phyin pa'i rnal 'byor pa rab yin na gdug pa can rnams dus ring por ma yin par tshar gcod nus/ 'bring gi dngos su sgrol ma thub kyang rten 'brel che bas gdug can de'i mthu stobs nyams te brtsams pa tshabs su mi 'gro bar bstan pa dang sems can la gnod pa cher mi nus pa'i rgyur 'gyur/ tha mas kyang bstan pa gces par 'dzin pa'i bsam pas nyams su blangs pas rang brgyud la bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po gong 'phel du 'gyur zhing / de la brten nas bde chen ye shes dus ring por ma yin par myur du skye ba'i rgyur bsgyur bas na mthar thug bstan pa bsrung ba'i mtshon char gtad pas mngon spyod mchog gi dngos grub du bsgyur ba la mkhas pa zhes bya ba'i don yin gsung / des na bsad pa'i las sbyor 'di la 'tshengs pa gsum zhes bya ste/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong sha khrag gis 'tshengs/ dgra bgegs gnas spar ba'i 'tshengs/ rang nyid kho'i tshe lhag bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad bsdus shing tshe 'dir dgra byed mkhan med pas 'tshengs pa yin gsungs so/ /khyad par thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag lde khar btags pa yig chung du shes par bya'o gsung / de yang rang dang gzhan gyi chags sdang la brten nas/ chos skyong bsnyen sgrub byed na dmyal bar ltung /

/bcos min snying rjes bstan dgra 'dul ba'i phyir/ /bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gang gis byed pa des/ /bskal pa mang po'i tshogs rdzogs 'gyur ro zhes/ /kho bo'i bla ma mthu stobs dbang phyug gsung / /bdud dpung kun 'joms bar chad kun sel ba'i/ /gdams ngag 'di 'dra thob pa skal ba bzang / /zhes pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /bzhi pa mnan pa'i 'khor lo mi phal cher dkyus bzhin las/ sngar bzlog pa'i skabs su ro ma rnams 'og gi khro bo'i zhabs 'og tu mnan pa dang / sbyin sreg byed pa rnams yin zhing / gzhan yang man ngag lde khar gdags pa/ bsgom pa'i 'khor lo'i man ngag sngags pa nang rgyas kyi man ngag gtor ma la brten nas dgra bo rang gshed rang la dbab pa'i man ngag zhar byung gi zhal shes kyi rnam grangs bstan pa dang bzhi/ dang po la/ nang dam tshig gi 'khor lo sems nyid ye shes kyi rtsal 'don pa gcig bar ye shes kyi 'khor lo lus lha'i rtsal 'don pa gnyis/ phyi rdzas kyi 'khor lo byin rlabs dang nus mthu'i rtsal 'don pa dang gsum/ gnyis pa la/ nyi zla kha sbyor byung na mdangs 'don pa'i man ngag gyogs gnyis nam mkha' 'thab na gyogs rdo bar snang du bcag pa'i man ngag seng ges kha 'thab byung na byin brlabs nus mthu'i rtsal 'don pa/ gsum pa la/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi shin tu drag po'i gtor ma zur du bstan pa dang lnga/ zhar byung rmi ngan bzlog pa e ka dza ṭa'i rims bsrung / shin tu zab pa'i man ngag shog dril drug rten dang mchod gtor gyi zhal shes/ thun mong gi bsnyen pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bsnyen pa/ srog 'phrog pa/ srog gi yang tig blangs pa/ ma 'grub na spog pa'i cho ga khro bcu'i gtor bzlog sogs bsam gyis mi khyab par shes par bya'o/ /'di rnams la yi ge zur na yod pa bzhin la/ zhal shes cung zad mthong ba brgyud pa'i lag len ltar shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa bzhi'i bsrung ba'i rtsal 'don pa ni/

dkyus kyi steng du 'khor lo las kyang 'khor lo dpag tu med par spros nas mtshon cha'i gur khang gi rgyab tu yang 'khor bas gnod byed thams cad rdo tshan la sbur mi chags pa bzhin du tshig phyir dpag tshad tsam du'ang nye bar mi nus par bsam/ gnyis pa bzlog pa'i rtsal 'don pa ni dkyus bzhin las/ bgegs bzlog na me 'od ral gri'i tshogs 'phros te bgegs rnams tshar bcad pa dang / nad rims bzlog na ye shes me rlung shugs drag tu 'phros pas/ dal yams kyi dngos po rlangs pa sngo dmar 'ja' tshon lta bu'i thibs se gnas pas/ de bsregs shing gtor bar bsam pa dang / rgyal po'i chad pa dang dmag jag rnams la sprul pa'i 'khor lo dang mtshon cha'i tshogs du mas bzlog bya de dag rtsa dang thal ba lta bu la/ bzlog byed rnams me dang rdo rje pha lam lta bus thogs med du bzlog cing tshar bcad par bsam mo/ /bsad mnan gnyis ni dkyus bzhin no/ /'di dag kyang rang rang gi dmigs pa'i mjug tu btags te skabs su bsgoms pas chog ga'i rgyun du ma grub kyang nyes pa med do/ /de ltar na bsrung bzlog bsad mnan bzhi'i sgo nas/ phyi bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la rten nas bsgrub pa phyi'i brag rdzong ma'i khrid re zhig bstan zin to// //zab mo'i gnad 'di thob phyin nyams len la brtson par dgos shing / de yang las tshogs gang bsgrub kyang thog mar gzhi'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin pa zhig mi dgos kha med yin pas/ gsum pa rjes bsnyen pa byed tshul ni/ bsnyen pa ma byas na lha'i thugs brgyud mi 'khul zhing / dngos grub rnams mi 'grub pa'i bsnyen pa la 'bad dgos la/ spyir mgon po 'di la sgrub tshul mang du yod kyang / bsnyen pa byed pa ni gegs chung zhing dngos grub myur ba'i tshogs bdag gi tshul du bsgrub pa zhes bya ste/ mgon po yi dam ltar bsgrub pa bdag bskyed la brten pa 'di la gtso bor mdzad de/ 'di la yi dam gzhan gyi gong bsnyen kyang sngon du 'gro mi dgos gsung /

ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa ni/ dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su dus ji tsam byed pa'i mtshams kyi rtsam pa me shing la sogs pa grabs su tshud par/ khang pa yang mtshams ma grol gyi bar du bdag chod nges byas la dam tshig gtsang ba'i bsgrub g.yog gnyis gsum re dang / lha rje gcig kyang 'jug cing / mtshams kyi sgang nang mchod kyang bshams dgos/ de yang rang la rgyus yod pa'i gtsang sa nas blangs la ma 'bags pa dgos pa sogs nye bar mkho ba mtha' dag ma tshang ba med par mtshams 'og tu bcug phyogs mtha'i yi ge sogs mi len du mi rung ba thams cad kyang dang po nas bcad rgya'i khongs su 'thus pa byas pas/ glo bur blang bas mtshams ral ba sogs kyi nyes pa mi 'byung ba'i gnad yin pas thog mar bcad rgya de ha cang dam drag pa min pa'i rgya che se byas don thob gang dam bya ba yin gsung / rang gi bsam gtan gyi 'bol nang tshangs can gyi 'og tu shing la sogs pa'i stegs bu sor bzhi tsam byas la/ rlung rgyug pa byas pa de'i 'og tu/ rdul tshon dkar po'am/ dkar gong phye ma gang rung gis rdo rje rgya gram bris la me tog sil ma gtor ro/ /rang nyid kha lhor blta ba'i mdun phyogs su bla ma yi dam srung mar bcas pa'i bris sku sogs rab gnas can gyi drung du mchod pa dang gtor ma lag len ltar bshams/ de yang yi dam gyi lha du la byed kyang zlum gtor gcig mgon po la chen po zur gsum/ lha mo la snying gzugs/ las mgon rnams la zur brgyad pa la zur bzhi gsal bar mngon par/ gzhan bzhi cung zad mi mngon par dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa la zur gsum che ba dbus bzhag pa'i phyogs bzhir zur gsum chung ba bzhis bskor ba/ spro na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang / gzhi bdag gtor ma yang bshams/ mtheb kyu ni yi dam rnams la ni/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i rnam pa can gyis mtheb kyu bskor ba/ mgon po rnams la mtheb kyus bcad kha phyir bstan pa brgya rtsa'i bskor ba/

mtheb kyus gtor ma gsum gnyis tsam nub pa/ 'jog sa ni rdo la sogs pa'i stegs bu'am/ bang kha sogs su byi ba la sogs pa'i skyon med par bzhag gtor ma'i rgyu la gzhan gyi rtsam pa ma 'dres par byed/ dkar rgyan dmar rgyan rnams ma 'bags pa byed/ gtor ma kha gso ba'i tshe lag pa bkru khyod na bkru/ bkru ma khyod na la go gyon nas brdzis te kha gso/ yang na mtheb kyu du ma bzos te rdo leb la sogs pa'i sa gtsang sar bzhag la gso ba'i tshe smyug ma kha rag bzos nas blangs te gso/ rang nyid stan rdo rje dril bu 'jog yul sogs kyang snga ma nas phyi mtshams ma grol bar du spo glog mi dgos par bya/ khang pa'i sgo rtsa ru mi mangs bsrung thub nges kyi mtshams su dkar tho legs par gdab/ dus nyer dgu'i srod lta bur gza' skar rtsub cing bzang ba nas dbu btsugs/ bsnyen pa la 'jug pa'i tshe dgong mo/ grogs dam tshig can gang 'os dang 'grogs nas 'byor pa dang bstun nas tshogs 'khor bshams te rol/ de nas stan khar 'dug ste rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams nam mkhar bzhugs nas bgegs bskrad par bsam la/ cha gsum yid ches pa lan gsum btang / de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas bzung thugs dam byed dgos rnams dang / gtor bsngo btang nas nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis nyal/ de nas tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs te/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed shes brgyud khul ngo shes pa brgya rtsa sogs ci rigs byas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom te tshigs bcad dam lhug pa gang yang rung ba'i sgo nas gsol 'debs gdungs shugs bskyed la brgya stong tsam byas/ bla ma rang sems dbyer med bsres nas mnyam par bzhag de nas srung 'khor brag rdzong ma ji lta bur nyams su blangs la bsrungs bya sba ba'i gnad yan chad legs par bsgom nas rang gur mgon du gsal ba'i lha gzhan rnams dang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa las sngags kyi sgra 'brug stong dus gcig tu grags pa ltar bsgrags cing me ri rab tu 'bar bas gnod byed rnams kyis 'ong mi nus shing /

tshur nye ba byung na skad cig la gzhob thul gyis tshig par bsam la/ mā hā ka la bzla/ thun 'jog khar shā sa na nyer gcig tsam re bzlas la/ mthar yang bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom ste gsol ba/ dung ba ji tsam nus kyi bar du btab la bla ma rang la bstim/ dge ba bsngo ba la sogs pa tshul bzhin byas te/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis tho rangs nas nyi ma shar tshun tsha ba thon nas nyi ma phyed tshun/ phyed yol nas nyi ma rgas tshun/ nyi ma rgas nas nam phyed tshun te/ mdor na 'char nub gnyis dang / phyed gnyis ni ting nge 'dzin 'jig pa'i dus yin pas/ de dag la thun mtshams khel nges par bya/ tshod ma skol mkhan gyi g.yog yod pa'am/ med na rang nyid kyi langs la thug pa bskol zhing thugs dam gzhan byed dgos pa la sogs pa'i thun mtshams kyi bya ba rnams byed/ de nas snga thun la zhugs nas/ nyi ma phyed tsam gyi tshe thun grol nas thun mtshams kyi bya ba rnams byed/ de nas dgong thun la zhugs nas/ nyi ma ri rtse la nub tsam gyi tshe thun grol nas sngar ltar thun mtshams kyi bya ba rnams byed/ de nas srod thun la 'jug gtor bsngo yang thun re re'i mjug tu re re bya ste/ na ba byung na yang thun bzhi'i dmigs pa ma chag tsam re byed dgos gsungs/ mtshams kyi sgang la phyogs nas yi ge byung na/ sngar nas phyogs 'di zhes bya ba nas yi ge byung na mjug bsam pa byas la/ rang gi mal sa ma yin pa'i sa gcig tu phyin nas/ yi ge blangs la yig len yang de nas bya/ mtshams ma grol gyi bar du mal sa dang / gtor ma 'jog sa dang / rdo dril 'jog pa rnams mi spo/ nang la phyag dar mi byed/ kha lag mi bkru/ stan mi sprug mal sa'i drod ma yal ba rnams kyang myur du 'grub ba'i gnad yin pas bla chos su ma song ba gces/ skra kha spu sen mo rnams mi 'breg kha mi bshal/ dngos grub myur du thob pa'i rten 'brel yod gsungs/ phyi nas mi gzhan gyis ma mthong bar byed cing /

sngags bzla ba'i skad gong bas tshor tsam byed mtshams kyi sgang la kha zas dkor dang ma 'dres par ngan ngon tsam la blo bkug na bsnyen rtags kyang myur du 'ong gsung / de yang mtshams la zhugs ma thag nas nyi mtshan ngo mi shes lta bu'i/ ba tshub rta tshub de 'phral 'jur 'dog po gcig yod na'ang / re zhig nas khams dub nas je lhod la song / rim gyi gegs dang nad 'jug pa yin pas/ thog ma nas khog grim la sos brdal yang ha cang 'jur 'jur du ma song bar bya/ bar du sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig tu dril nas 'jur la btab ste nyams su blangs/ 'jug na mar yang hob ste bzhag pa lta bu ma yin par je yang je lhod la btang ste dge sbyor nas 'dra zhig byas na gegs chung la khe che ba yin pas/ de lta bu'i tshul gyi zhag gsum sogs ci rigs su thun bzhir bcad nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su blangs/ de nas zhag gsum sogs bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang gsol 'debs brgya rtsa re tsam thun mgor gtso bor yi ge brgya pa'i bsgom bzlas nyams su len pa ni gegs chung zhing dngos grub myur bas bsam sbyang gi gnad yin pas/ nges par byas la zhag grangs ni longs skabs dang bstun nas bya'o/ /de rnams grub nas thun mgor bla ma'i rnal 'byor nges par dgos/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ma grub kyang chad pa'i skyon med/ dngos gzhi rdo rje brag rjong ma 'khor lo jag par bkye ba yan bsgom pa'i rjes su/ 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor ba'i rang sgra dang me 'od kyis bar chad thams cad gzhob thul bsreg pa dang / lha rnams zhal nang du gzigs bdag dang bsrung bya la thugs rtse gcig pas dgongs shing / sngags kyi nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs pa la sems gtad de bzlas la/ ngag bcad dam pos tshig gi gzhan gyi bar ma 'dres par bya/ de yang rgyun gyi thugs dam la ni long skabs kyi ma grub na/ dmigs pa rnams ngag bcad dam po'i ngang nas bsgrub bzlas pa rjes spyod du 'du ba'i steng nas byas kyang rung mod/

bsnyen pa'i skabs 'dir/ skyabs 'gro nas bsngo ba'i bar ngag ma shor ba dang / gtso bor shes pa gu yangs kyi 'og 'gyu rgya 'byams kyi ngang nas gang tsam bzlas kyang / gzhan la mi 'phro'i tshul gyis ni/ /de lta'i tshul gyis bzlas pa bya/ /yul gzhan blo ni 'phro ba yis/ /bskal par bsgrub kyang mi 'grub bo/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ sems gzhan g.yengs pas byas pa ni/ /de nyid rig pas don med gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'bras bu myur du 'byin mi nus pas dmigs pa rtse gcig yid ma yengs pa ni nges par dgos/ bzlas bya'i sngags ni/ yi ge bcu gnyis pa dang / yi ge bdun pa gang rung yin mod/ phyag len gtso bor yi ge bdun pa mdzad pas thun gyi dngos gzhi yi ge bdun pa khri tsam sogs gang 'gro dang / thun mjug tu/ bzlog pa sogs dgos skabs dang bstun pa'i bzlog 'khor shā sa na nyer gcig drug cu rtsa bzhi sogs gang 'os bzla ba yin la/ de'i grangs ni/ legs grub kyi rgyud las/ yi ge bco brgyad man chod la/ /mkhas pas yi ge 'bum gyi grangs/ /yi ge sum cu so gnyis la/ /'bum phrag bzhi'i grangs kyis so/ /de nas lhag pa'i yi ge la/ /'bum gcig gis ni grangs kyis so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rjes 'brang na/ yi ge bco lnga man chad la spyir 'bru 'bum mdzad kyang / 'dir rgyas par rje btsun chen pos 'grel pa/ gur rgyan du bzhed pa 'bru re la 'bum phrag brgyad brgyad de lnga bcu rtsa drug gam/ yang rdzogs ldan dus su gcig bzlas pas/ /rtsod ldan dus su bzhi'i gyur bzlas/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bdun bzhi nyi shu rtsa brgyad dam/ da lta skyus ma ni/ 'bum phrag bcu drug gis grangs bsnyen rdzogs par bzhed/ 'on kyang 'di la ni mtshan ma kho na las grangs mi gtso gsungs/ mtshan ma ni rab dngos/ 'bring nyams/ tha ma rmi lam la sogs par nag po chen po'i sku mthong ba/ ha ha'i gad rgyangs drag po 'jigs su rung ba lta bu'i gsung thos pa/

bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin lta bu thugs mthong ba'am/ bya nag khyi nag mi nag lce spyang / g.yag rgod/ mkha' lding sogs gzi brjid can du ma 'du zhing dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur byed pa/ pha ma dang / slob dpon dang / yul gyi mi chen dang / hor dang / sog po dang / a tsa ra la sogs pa'ang 'byung zhing / de dag dga' mgu'i tshul gyis rang la 'dud pa sogs byed cing / bya mchu 'dum dang / mtshon cha rtse chag gri yu ba med pa sogs byung na/ sngags ma dag pas zhu dag byas/ yug sa ma/ mdze pho mo/ bud med ngu ba/ lha dang mchod cha chags pa sogs rmi na nyams chags kyi rtags yin pas/ bskang bshags la 'bad/ gtor ma gtong ba'i lang long dang / rang yang ltog pa snyam byed pa/ ston mo'i skal ba chad pa sogs rmi na gtor ma gsar pa bzang du bshams nas 'bul/ gnyid du rang dbang med par 'gro ba dang / g.yal mang po yong na phud nyams pa yin pas phud phye sman phud sogs gsar du ma nyams pas kha gso 'bag dang spre'u sogs rgyal rmi cung zad byung na/ spyir ni mgon po 'di'i ltas la rgyal rmi mang tsam yong bas long rgyu cher med/ 'on kyang de dag gis rgol ba dang / 'jigs snang 'char na/ bzlog 'khor la skyon pas rang zhir 'gyur/ gzhan yang sgo rdung ba/ thog 'tsheg pa/ shug pa 'bod pa/ 'jigs ngam ngam 'ong ba/ 'od 'khyug pa sogs dang / grib non lta bur 'ong ba ni/ nag po chen po grub pa'i rtags rgyud dur khrod nag po las gsungs pa ltar/ 'dre non du grags pa/ 'di 'dra bas thib thib/ gnon pa ni nges par 'byung / go gyon pa/ rdzong nang na 'dug la 'khor du mas bskor ba sogs bsrung ba 'grub pa'i ltas/ sha rlon pa dmar rtser ba/ mgo lag dang glo snying 'byin pa/ sems can bsad pa/ bzung ba/ srog chags ma rung ba bsad pa sogs byung na/ nges par bzlog pa grub pa'i rtags yin la/ rgyang glu len pa/ rta bong gi khyu mang po sogs byung na/ dmigs pa g.yel bas cung zad mi 'grub pa'i ltas yin pas/

dmigs pa rtse gcig tu bcun zhing rmi lam bzlog pa nyams su blangs/ de yang bsnyen sgrub la sogs kyi tshe rmi lam ngan pa'am/ ltas ngan pa'i bye brag ci byung yang / nyam nga bag tsha bar mi bya bar de ma thag tu/ rang nag po chen por lam gyis gsal ba'i thugs khar/ las kyi gshin rje dmar nag g.yas ral gri/ g.yon sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ gnod byed la rngam pa'i zhal gdangs pa de'i lte bar rgyab phyogs su nyi ma'i rang bzhin gyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad g.yas su 'khor ba/ mdun du zla ba'i rang bzhin 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad g.yon du 'khor ba gsal btab la/ rang gi thugs kha'i 'od kyi rmi ngan ltas ngan gang yin pa de mdun du bkug nas bsgyel de skrag nas nyam thag par bsam la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ shā sa na/ zhes pa nas i dam duṣ+ṭa'i bar ngag tu brjod/ de nas khas rngub pa'i stang ka bya zhing / gnod byed rang dbang med par zhal du rngub/ dmar chil li gsol te mid pas thugs kha'i gshin rje'i khar song / des kyang zhib par bldad nas mid pas lto ba'i nyi zla kha sbyor gyi bar du tshud de/ 'khor lo g.yas g.yon du 'khor bas phye mar bya/ nyi ma'i mes bsregs/ zla ba'i 'gyur byed kyi chus sbyangs pa'i mthar/ stong gsum gyi pha mthar yud kyis khyer nas stong nyid du thim par bsam rlung bzung nas pho ba g.yas g.yon du bskor/ yid kyi dmigs nas/ rmi ngan kha kha nas rmi ngan di na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar bzlas 'phral rlung drag tu phyir 'bud/ yang de ma thag mdun du dgug pa sogs sngar bzhin rlung 'bud pa'i bar nyer gcig byas pas/ bsnyen pa rdzogs pa rnams la ni de ma thag bsad rtags dang / gus pas 'dud pa sogs 'byung bar snang zhing / nges par rmi ltas ngan pa zlog nges pa'i zab tig 'di yang shin tu gces shing mkho ba yin no/ /mdor na de lta bu'i tshul gyi bsnyen pa'i ltas thengs gsum tsam rgyun mar byung gi bar ram/

grangs 'di tsam 'dren dam bcas pa de rdzogs pa na/ gtang rag gi tshul du mchod gtor tshogs 'khor rgyas par bya zhing / dam tshig dang ldan pa'i nang mi gtsang ma gnyis gsum tsam la 'phrad pa nas rim bzhin je mang la 'phrad/ grib dang 'dris su bcug la/ phyi nang gi mtshams rim bzhin grol/ de yang / mtshams grol du nyi ba'i tshe/ thugs dam yang du btang / grol khar mtshams 'og tu bcug pa'i grogs gcig gam gnyis bos nas/ thun mtshams rgyun ring bar byas la klog la sogs pa byed/ de nas sang nyin rang gi khang pa'i rgyab tu thon nas bskor ba lta bu byed/ de'i sang nyin rang gi khang thog tu phyin nas bskor ba dang / phyi na yod pa'i mi rnams dang / dngos su mi 'phrad par rgyang nas mthong bar byed/ de'i sang nyin ri kha lta bu'i mtho ba dang / gang 'os su skyo sang la 'gro zhing / mi dang dngos su ma 'phrad tsam byed/ des na mtshams la hob thon du mi grol bar grib dang 'dris su bcug la dal bu dal bus grol dgos gsung / mdor na thog mtha' gnyis su cung zad lhod pa/ bar du sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig tu sgrim nas shin tu 'jur ba ste/ dge sbyor nas 'dra lta bu byed pa ni mtshams gang byed kyi gnad zab mo yin no/ /de lta bu'i tshul gyi bsnyen pa legs par thim nas/ bstan pa dang rang gzhan gyi don du las kyi tshogs rab 'byams bsgrub pa la dbang ba'i zhal shes phyag khrid dang ldan pas nyams su blangs te rang gzhan la phan gdags par bya'o/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i bstan srung kun gyi mchog /dpal ldan gur gyi mgon po'i lam gyi bcud/ /mchog thun grub gnyis bde blag stsol ba 'di/ /sa skya'i rje btsun thugs kyi nying khu yin/ /gang 'di brgyud pa'i rim pa ma nyams shing / /snyan brgyud byin rlabs sarga ma log par/ /deng sang ma nub yol sgor thob pa rnams/ /brjed byang bkod 'di rang gi dran gso'o/ /skal mnyam gzhan la'ang phan pa ma bkag mod/

/'on kyang deng dus 'di 'drar dad nyung bas/ /gdams pa 'di yang nya pas rin chen snyed/ /rnam par smad nas dor bzhin gyur gyi dogs/ /legs bshad 'di ni chos rje mkhyen rtse dbang / /ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa'i gsung rab rnams/ /phan tshun 'thor ba spang phyir gcig tu bsdus/ /rang bzos tshig sbyor ci yang ma bris lags/ /'di 'dra rang gi byung na don gnyis kyi/ /dpal rnams grub la bdud dpung tshar gcod cing / /mi 'gyur thar pa'i mchog gi rgyal srid che/ /nges par thob pa'i dpal de lag na 'dug /dbang dang byin brlabs khrid bka' ma thob pas/ /dpe 'di mthong kyang blta bar mi byed la/ /snying 'dra slob ma ma gtogs kun la ni/ /chos brgyud shod la dpe brgyud mkha' dbyings sbos/ /gal te brgyud pa mi zin blo rmongs la/ /'di'i nang nas gdams pa cha shas tsam/ /sbyin nas dal 'byor don ldan la sbyor sogs/ /rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las rgya chen mdzod/ /dge 'dis bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa'i/ /snyan brgyud slob bshad bdud rtsi'i dga' ston gyis/ /skal bzang skye bo'i snying gi me long la/ /grub gnyis ltad mo ci yang rgyas gyur cig /ces dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rdo rje brag rdzong ma'i 'khrid kyi brjed byang bdud dpung tshar gcod ces pa 'di ni/ shākya'i dge slong snyoms las pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis rang gi dran gsor chos rje mkhyen brtse ba'i 'khrid yig na mi gsal ba rnams/ mkhas grub ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa'i yig cha nas kha bskangs te/ 'phags pa'i yul na pra dza pa ti/ bod skad du skyes bdag zhes pa lcags mo lug lo hor zla brgyad pa'i nyer lnga'i nyin dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi chos grwar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni/ shar mi nyag gi btsun pa shes rab bzang po'o/ /dpe 'di mgon po'i rjes gnang 'khrid sogs ma thob pa la mi ston pa'i bka' rgya yod do//
